pages.text: The power of a large engine depends on the fuel's torque factor (see the fuel table in the Engines chapter). With the default stress settings, at 128 RPM:

$(li)$(item)Large Engine$(): about 26,400 su x torque factor. Diesel or kerosene: about 37,000 su. Naphtha: about 34,300 su. Furnace gas: about 7,900 su.$(li)$(item)Simple Large Engine$(): about 19,200 su x torque factor. Diesel: about 26,900 su. Furnace gas: about 5,800 su.

$(l)Goggle lines (since 1.3.0)$()$(li)$(item)Needs a Powered Shaft 2 blocks in front$(): place or turn the shaft.$(li)$(item)Needs Air in its air tank$(): feed it air.$(li)$(item)No fuel$(): pipe fuel in.$(li)$(item)Unsupported fuel: use diesel, kerosene, naphtha or furnace gas$(): drain the tank and change fuel.
$(li)$(item)Exhaust full: pump the CO2 away$().$(br2)Below these lines the goggles list the three tanks, so you can see which one is empty or full.
